name: Observer demo, humanoid look and motion
about: The observer demo (research/24_simulated_studies_plan.md section 13; question in 25_observer_question.md). Six EgoBody moments, chosen by a fixed rule (the most upper-body motion), each acted out four ways in Isaac Sim in the scan of the real room, seen from where the partner stood: the SMPL-X human body or the Unitree G1, moving with the wearer's recorded motion or with the same poses every 0.5 s joined at constant speed (robotic). TRIBE v2 predicts the observer's cortex for each 9 s clip. AIP is where Saygin et al. 2012 report the android effect.
